$comment: ADR 0118 O1. The offline floor, declared so it can be checked rather than asserted. Every family in picoOfflineFloorFamilies must appear here; scripts/check-offline-floor.mjs resolves each module's transitive import closure and fails on a forbidden reachable import. A family that is not built yet says so, with a reason, so a partial floor can never read as a complete one.

forbidden.$comment: Outbound reach and model providers. Servers are deliberately absent: a loopback listener is how the person's own device talks to itself, and forbidding it would make the floor unimplementable rather than network-free. What is forbidden is code that reaches out.

familyForbidden.$comment: ADR 0129 SR5. Forbidden to one family rather than to all. A mobile runtime that captures location has to call a sensor API; the derivation must not, or the port is a suggestion and the meaning of parking is tied to one operating system.
